title: The Ravager's Tower
objective: Climb the ruined watchtower where a gnoll has laired with its plunder, take what you can, and get back out alive. Leave by the tower door when you are ready.

rooms.name: Tower Foot
rooms.description: The ground floor of a broken watchtower, open to the sky where the upper floors have fallen in. A spiral stair climbs the wall. Bones crunch underfoot.

features.name: Dead Pedlar
features.description: A pedlar's body lies at the foot of the stair, half gnawed.
features.discovery: The gnoll missed two stoppered vials of red liquid, one in the pedlar's boot and one sewn into the pedlar's coat.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Gnoll's Roost
rooms.description: The last floor still standing, high above the moor. Plunder from the road lies heaped among stinking furs.

features.name: Plunder Heap
features.description: Torn packs, broken crates and bloodied cloth piled against the parapet.
features.discovery: Among the rubbish are a pedlar's cashbox, a gilt-bronze icon still in its travelling case, and a pair of pearl earrings.

items.name: Pedlar's Cashbox
items.description: A tin cashbox of gold pieces.

items.name: Gilt-bronze Icon
items.description: A hinged icon of gilded bronze, painted with a saint.

items.name: Pearl Earrings
items.description: A pair of small pearls on gold wires.

items.name: Gnoll Ravager's Coins
items.description: A small pouch of silver pieces.

passages.description: The spiral stair, missing every third step, climbs to the top floor.

opponents.description: A hyena-headed gnoll rises from its furs, spear in hand, laughing its high, mad laugh.

endings.title: Out with the plunder
endings.text: You climb down out of the tower with the gnoll's plunder on your back.

endings.title: Out of the tower
endings.text: You climb down out of the tower with nothing to show for it.

endings.title: Fallen in the tower
endings.text: You fall among the bones. Your adventuring ends here.
